paragraphs: Midrash Shmuel mentions him and R' Yehoshua of Sikhnin reporting in the name of R' Levi. Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot read R' Yehudah ben Niron.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ד is contextually Seder HaDorot alongside Yuchasin, without author/edition identification or fresh source verification. ר״י is locally Yehudah with title R'; the other three personal titles likewise stay R'.

Nirin/Niron preserve the two actual patronymics without correction or identity admission. He and Yehoshua jointly report Levi, without an added object or singular reporter. Machine אמרי/נרסי differs from supplied אמרו/גרסי, preserved as provenance. Sikhnin is contextual locative rendering only.
